scope: Fresh host CPU reproduction of one identified Hand Landmarker component; not a replay of unavailable historical review records.
contract_evidence: Official metadata schema output ordering and MediaPipe v0.10.14 hand_landmarks_detector_graph.cc index 0 landmarks, index 2 handedness. Coordinates are normalized in postprocessing.
variants: swap metadata entries 0 and 2 in place
checks: All changes confined to metadata buffer 172; all other buffers and all other file bytes preserved
Record raw javac failures before any identical separator-only repairs
Compile repaired wrappers and same consumer; inspect javap bindings
CPU interpreter inference on 12 predeclared synthetic float32 inputs and every output of every variant
synthetic_inputs: eight uniform [0,1) inputs from numpy default_rng seed 20261003
runtime: tflite-runtime 2.14.0, one thread, default CPU interpreter. Exact equality is reported empirically, not generalized to every input/device.
limits: Synthetic input tests do not validate handedness accuracy or real image behavior
No Android deployment or generated wrapper inference is assumed
A successful metadata swap need not correct every semantic metadata issue
